market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH is at ~$2,290-2,330 on May 7, 2026. Reaching $1,500 requires a ~35% decline by year-end (about 8 months). ETH has historically had such drawdowns in bear cycles, but current price is well above $1,500 with no clear catalyst. Base rate moderate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shocks or crypto cycle reversal could trigger 35%+ drop; no immediate catalyst visible.
